_comment: The family envelope as named fractions, so both marks can be generated from
one set of numbers instead of matching by eye. Every value here was measured.
The disagreement between the two drawings is real: 1.443 here against 1.189
there. Neither was decided - both are generator output that was measured
afterwards. So this is not 'which app is right', it is 'the family has no
envelope yet and needs one chosen'.
Cinemail's session proposes this file live at the My Apps root, which both
repos already load, rather than as a copy in each - a copied constants file
diverges the first time somebody edits the near one.

_retracted: withdrawn by the Cinemail session after re-measuring. Their flap edge
flattens to 0.033 of the envelope height between x=0.30 and x=0.40, so the
topmost white pixel there is decided by one pixel of antialiasing and can
land anywhere across a wide span. The off-centre apex was that noise.
Nothing in their file argues against a centred apex.
cinemail_master_measured._note: Their envelope was generated and then traced. There is no authored version to be faithful to, so 'redraw Tunemail to match Cinemail' is not a thing that can be done.
